200.description: Signed in: the session cookie is set and the code is used up

400.description: Not signed in: the request breaks the contract (a name out of its rules too, before the code is tried), or the code is wrong, expired or void

403.description: The request was sent from a page of another site

429.description: Too many sign-in tries from this address

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request is answered.

post.summary: Signs the browser out: deletes its session on the server, then clears its cookies; without a session it only clears them

403.description: The session was sent from a page of another site

500.description: The session could not be deleted; the cookie is kept, so it can be retried

get.summary: Tells a page whether its browser is signed in: the account of its session, or `null` without one (never `401`, as every page asks)

500.description: The session could not be read

name.description: Required on named events (2–30 characters trimmed), absent on anonymous ones.

votes.description: One state per option ID: every option of the event exactly once.

CastVote.description: A participant’s answer to every option of the event.

title.description: 1–50 characters as people see them, once trimmed.

organizerName.description: 2–30 characters as people see them, once trimmed.

timeZone.description: IANA name of the organizer’s time zone, e.g. `Europe/Madrid`: today, the options and the deadline are read in it.

deadline.description: Last day of voting, from today to twelve months ahead in `timeZone`, as the options; voting closes at its end.

note.description: At most 150 characters as people see them, once trimmed; empty or only spaces is no note.

anonymous.description: Whether participants vote without a name.

options.description: 1 to 60, from today to the same day twelve months later in `timeZone`, in any order: the API stores them in chronological order.

CreateEvent.description: A new event, owned by the account of the session; the email of its summary is the account’s.

time.description: Null for a whole day; times only appear on single dates.

ProposedOption.description: One date the organizer proposes: a day, a range of days, or a day with a time or time range.

optionId.description: The ID of one of the event’s options.

ConfirmOption.description: The option the organizer confirms as final.

email.description: The email the code is sent to; trimmed and compared in lower case.

SignInCodeRequest.description: The email to send a sign-in code to.

email.description: The email the code is sent to; trimmed and compared in lower case.

code.description: The 6 digits of the last code sent to the email.

name.description: The name an account created by this sign-in takes, 2–30 characters as people see them, once trimmed; an email that has an account keeps its name.

SignInRequest.description: The email, the code sent to it and, optionally, the name of a new account.

text.description: The phrase that says when, in Spanish, Catalan or English; 1 to 120 characters once trimmed.

timeZone.description: IANA name of the time zone the phrase is written in, e.g. `Europe/Madrid`: today and the time now are taken in it.

region.description: The region of the browser’s language, two capital letters, e.g. `ES` or `US`: it orders a date in figures ("7/4" is 4 July in the United States). Any other text is read as no region (day/month), never refused.

HealthOk.description: The API and its database answer.

state.description: Closed once the deadline has passed, even before anything else changes it.

PublicEvent.description: What a participant may see of an event: never the organizer email, tokens, counts or votes.

time.description: Null for a whole day; times only appear on single dates.

Option.description: One date the organizer offers; its dates and times are read in the event’s time zone.

ValidationFailed.description: The request breaks the contract (e.g. a path with broken percent-encoding, a body that is not JSON).

FieldProblem.description: A part of the request that breaks its schema.

EventCancelled.description: The event was cancelled; its title is kept.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this address; the `Retry-After` header says how many seconds to wait.

InternalError.description: The request failed unexpectedly; it can be retried.

VoteCast.description: The stored vote; the same answer for a repeated send.

VoteRejected.description: Nothing was stored: the request breaks the contract, the vote breaks a rule of the event, or the token already belongs to a vote of another event.

VotingClosed.description: The deadline has passed, the organizer closed voting or confirmed a date.

name.description: The trimmed name; absent on anonymous events.

votes.description: One state per option ID of the event.

MyVote.description: The answer stored under a vote-edit token.

Forbidden.description: The token holds no vote of this event (none at all, or one of another event).

EditVoteRejected.description: Nothing was changed: the request breaks the contract or the vote breaks a rule of the event.

final.description: False while voting is open (the results are provisional), true after.

outcome.description: Which sentence the results say: no winner (`no-votes`, `nobody-can-attend`), one, two, three or four or more winners (`several`), or every option winning (`all`).

attending.description: Voters who can attend a winner; 0 with no winner.

winnersListed.description: Whether the winners are listed under the sentence: one to three.

alternatives.description: As well attended as the winners but less preferred: most preferred first, then in chronological order.

Results.description: What the votes of an event amount to: the winners and their alternatives, never a full ranking.

ResultsOption.description: One option shown in the results; its attendance is `preferred + available`.

ResultsForbidden.description: The ID is the participation link of an event, which never opens its results.

participationId.description: The ID of the participation link.

resultsId.description: The ID of the results link.

EventCreated.description: The new event’s links, with the management token the page sent; the same answer for a repeated send.

EventRejected.description: Nothing was created: every rule the event breaks, in the order of the wizard’s steps, the parts of the request that break the contract, or alone `MANAGEMENT_TOKEN_TAKEN`: the token already holds an event of another account.

index.description: The option’s place in the list as sent, from 0: the field `options[index]`.

Unauthenticated.description: The request carries no credential that could grant it.

CrossSiteSession.description: The session was sent from a page of another site, or without `Origin`: it cannot change anything.

state.description: Closed once the deadline has passed, even before anything else changes it.

recommendedOptionIds.description: The options the results recommend (their winners), in chronological order; empty with no votes or when nobody can attend.

participationId.description: The ID of the participation link.

resultsId.description: The ID of the results link.

ManagedEvent.description: What the organizer sees of an event to manage it, with the facts a decision needs: how many voted and which options are recommended.

ManagementForbidden.description: The credential does not manage this event: another event’s token, any other link, the session of another account, or an event that does not exist. A change sent with the session from a page of another site, or without `Origin`, is refused the same way.

ConfirmationRejected.description: Nothing was confirmed: the request breaks the contract, or the option is not one of the event’s.

AlreadyConfirmed.description: Another option is already confirmed: a confirmation is final.

MyEvents.description: Every event the account created, newest first; a cancelled event is no longer one of them.

id.description: The participation ID of the event’s link, the one every management path takes: `/api/events/{id}`.

state.description: Closed once the deadline has passed, even before anything else changes it.

deadline.description: Last day of voting, in the event’s time zone.

MyEvent.description: One event of the signed-in account, as its list shows it.

resendAfterSeconds.description: Seconds until a new code may be asked for the same email.

SignInCodeSent.description: A new 6-digit code was delivered to the email; it replaces the last one and is valid for 10 minutes and 5 wrong tries.

ForeignPage.description: The request was sent from a page of another site, or without `Origin`.

CodeNotDelivered.description: The email server did not take the code email; asking again sends a new code.

SignedIn.description: The browser is signed in: its session cookie is set.

attemptsLeft.description: Wrong tries left for this code.

WrongCode.description: The code is not the last one sent to the email.

CodeExpired.description: The email has no valid code: it expired after 10 minutes, was already used, or was never sent.

TooManyAttempts.description: The code was void after 5 wrong tries, even if this one is right.

SignedOut.description: The session is deleted and its cookies cleared.

name.description: Empty until the account creates its first event or names itself.

SignedInAccount.description: The account the browser is signed in as.

nextDay.description: Present when the range ends on the day after it starts.

question.description: The place of its question in `questions`.

time.description: Null for a whole day or a range of days. `question`: the half of the day was not said, and the time is the reading of that question the organizer picks.

options.description: The options to mark; none with `tooMany` or when nothing is understood.

fragment.description: The words of the phrase that said the time.

dates.description: Every date the time is asked of.

nextDay.description: Present when the range ends on the day after it starts.
Present when the range ends on the day after it starts.

questions.description: One "morning or afternoon?" question per distinct time whose half of the day was not said.

fragment.description: The words of the phrase the notice speaks of.

dates.description: The first day of each marked option the fragment speaks of; none for a vague time said of no day.

fragment.description: The words of the phrase the notice speaks of.

dates.description: The first day of each marked option the fragment speaks of; none for a vague time said of no day.

written.description: How the phrase wrote the day whose midnight is the day marked: a date ("el 20 de junio") or not ("el sábado", "mañana").

fragment.description: The words of the phrase the notice speaks of.
The words of the phrase the notice speaks of.

items.description: One thing the organizer is told. About days that are marked: `timeUnclear` (the time was not understood), `tooLate` (the time range ends after 06:00 of the next day; no time is kept), `dayNotWritten` (midnight said of a day is 00:00 of the next one). About what gave no option: `unclear` (not understood), `mismatch` (a date that does not exist or does not fit), `past` (a date already past), `horizon` (beyond 12 months), each without `fragment` when it speaks of the whole phrase, `pastTime` (a time of today already past) and `tooMany` (above 60 options: nothing is marked).

notices.description: One notice per fragment, every one that applies.

DateInterpretation.description: What a phrase says about when: options, questions and notices, each in the phrase’s order. Dates and times carry no zone.
